groups.why: Purge valves PV-101 ~ PV-703 of the 7 conveying lines: the purge runs only when that line is not conveying (L5-1 Sec 4), but its duration / cycle is NOT IN DOCS (set at commissioning). Phase 11 (SUZU 2026-11-27) made the blow tank cycle, the hopper vibrators and the silo level from the design data (src/analog/engine/pkg.js pkgFaStep); the purge stays with no value until a purge time is found. Owner Phase 11.

Control Mode Remote and Ash Silo Unloading System Auto: no document says which mode the plant uses (the dry unloader is local only, FA p13, p37). NO-SOURCE after YUA read 2026-11-27 (phase8-image-docs-2026-11-27.md): L5-1 Sec 1 / Sec 4, K1AU3-D1-0-017 p40 / p60 / p137 ~ 169, D2-0-017, D2-0-016, L19-1 parts 4 / 5 / 7.

TR01 ~ 05 primary / secondary kV and mA: normal running values NOT IN DOCS (L19-1 part 7 says only "at the threshold of sparking"). Ratings: U-1201 83 kVDC / 840 mA, U-1202 ~ 1205 72 kVDC / 1,000 mA (L19-1 part 4, ED p103, p107). The running value depends on the gas and dust in the field: an ESP electrical model, Phase 11.
